name: ansari-faithful-answers
description: Ansari's MCP application with the SAGA React FaithfulCard

scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm build:worker && pnpm test && pnpm test:browser
scripts.guard:dev-vars: test ! -e .dev.vars || { echo 'A generic .dev.vars is read by every environment: rename it to .dev.vars.<env> for the one environment it belongs to.' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.dev:worker:dev: pnpm guard:dev-vars && pnpm build:worker && CLOUDFLARE_LOAD_DEV_VARS_FROM_DOT_ENV=false wrangler dev --env dev
scripts.dev:worker:beta: pnpm guard:dev-vars && pnpm build:worker && CLOUDFLARE_LOAD_DEV_VARS_FROM_DOT_ENV=false wrangler dev --env beta
scripts.dev:worker:production: pnpm guard:dev-vars && pnpm build:worker && CLOUDFLARE_LOAD_DEV_VARS_FROM_DOT_ENV=false wrangler dev --env production
scripts.deploy:worker:dev: pnpm build:worker && wrangler deploy --env dev --var ANSARI_RELEASE:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
scripts.deploy:worker:beta: pnpm build:worker && wrangler deploy --env beta --var ANSARI_RELEASE:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
scripts.deploy:worker:production: pnpm build:worker && wrangler deploy --env production --var ANSARI_RELEASE:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
